title: Ubugingo bw'Umugende
intro: Usubira mu gihe umutware w’umunyaruyeri yasaba ko umuntu yihebera imana z’ikinyoma bimwe bishitse. Umuryango mutoyi w’imitima yihebeye Imana waranka, maze uhura n’igihano gikomeye cane ku buryo cacitse umuvumo w’ibihe bidahera. Inkuru yabo irasubiramwo muri Korowani nk’igihe c’ukwizera kudahungabana. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo mugwi ushikamye?
clues: Twari mu gihugu cari kiganzwa n’agahahazo k’umutware yasaba gusenga imana z’ikinyoma .
Umuryango wacu warashikiwe n'uruhamo rukomeye kubera gusa twemera Allah wenyene .
Uwo mutware yategetse ko bacukura umugende munini maze bakawucumbisha imbeya zikaze .
Kubera ko twanse guheba ukwizera kwacu, twaterewe muri ico cobo caka umuriro umwe umwe .
Inkuru yacu yaciye iba igice ca Korowani, kandi abadutoteza baravumwe ibihe bidahera .
Sura yandika ingorane zacu yitwa izina ry’ibimenyetso bikomeye vyo mw’ijuru vyo mw’ijuru .

trial.label: Ikigeragezo cacu
options: Guturirwa ari muzima mu mwobo w’umuriro .
Kuba yapfungiwe mu mwobo imyaka myinshi .
trial.answer: Guturirwa ari muzima mu mwobo w’umuriro .

outcome.answer: Twarapfuye abamaratiri kandi abadutoteza baravumwe ibihe bidahera .

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
